name: Hindustan Unilever
business_summary: India's largest fast-moving consumer goods company with 50+ brands across 16 categories including Lifebuoy, Surf Excel, Dove, Knorr, and Brooke Bond.

strengths: Reach across 9 out of 10 Indian households
Exceptional pricing power and brand moat
Zero debt with high dividend payout ratio
weaknesses: Palm oil and crude derivative packaging input costs
Rural disposable income and monsoon sensitivity
Intense local and D2C brand competition in premium niches
